en: Vintage colored postcard showing a broad, straight avenue lined with trees and tram tracks in a historic city. On the right stands a large Art Nouveau building with a tall spire; in the distance a cathedral with multiple towers rises against hilly, green surroundings. The front has printed captions at the bottom and appears slightly worn. The reverse side contains handwritten text in Hungarian, printed postcard dividing lines, and a publisher's stamp.
